cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Grandpa will retire from the post office next year.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷明年将从邮局退休。

cards.example_en: The sun will rise behind the hills before breakfast.

cards.example_en: Her monthly salary covers the rent and the groceries.
cards.example_zh: 她每月的薪水够付租金和买菜的钱。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The school secretary printed the letters after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 学校秘书午饭后把那些信打印了出来。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Her short speech made the hall go completely quiet.
cards.example_zh: 她简短的演讲让礼堂里完全安静下来。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Kitchen staff prepared sandwiches for the sports day.
cards.example_zh: 厨房人员为运动会准备了三明治。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Leave wet sports stuff outside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 把湿的运动用品放在教室门外。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs

cards.example_zh: 在这部话剧里，橄榄枝是和平的象征。

cards.example_zh: 星期五，整理图书馆的书成了我的任务。

cards.example_zh: 洪水成了河边那些房子的威胁。

cards.example_en: Even a light touch on his arm made him jump.
cards.example_zh: 哪怕轻轻碰一下他的胳膊，他都会吓得跳起来。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Wool trade kept the harbour busy for years.
cards.example_zh: 羊毛贸易让这个港口热闹了好多年。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Grandpa hummed an old tune while washing the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷洗碗的时候哼着一首老调子。
